description: The Phase 4 demo script (design section 20): twenty paragraphs of cues in spoken form, a short documentary about an invented lake valley through one year, with pronunciation hints for its invented names and a few exact spans.
freeze: Frozen as version 1 on 2026-09-27, after gate H1 (plan.md section 5): the owner listened to sample renders and approved them. A frozen set never changes: the Phase 4 acceptance test runs this script (design section 20), so a changed text is a new set, demo-en.v2.
